title: What to do when you wake up at 2 a.m. and cannot fall back asleep
dek: Waking up in the middle of the night is common, and a few gentle habits can make it less frustrating.
keywords: how to get back to sleep
body: If you are reading this at two in the morning, you are probably not reading it on purpose. Maybe you woke up and your mind started running through tomorrow. A lot of people know that feeling.
One of the least helpful things to do is check the time over and over. Every glance at the clock turns into math about how many hours are left, and the math tends to make you more awake.

Keeping things dim and boring often helps. Turn the clock away. Breathe slowly and count the breaths, and when you lose count, start again at one. If you are still awake after a while, get up, sit somewhere quiet with low light and read something plain until you feel sleepy.

It also helps to be kind to yourself about it. One rough night does not ruin a week, and tomorrow may feel better than you fear it will. If waking up like this keeps happening for weeks, that is worth mentioning to a doctor.
Tonight, put the phone down after this, turn the clock away and let yourself rest even if sleep takes a while to come back.
